sources.scope: Site::QoderCn only: accounts, auth, device PKCE, refresh, COSY/body codec, models, context, messages, SSE, usage and campaigns
sources.changes: Ported into an isolated wasm32-unknown-unknown provider. Files, environment access, native thread state and direct networking replaced with controlled host services. COSY AES/RSA operations use maintained RustCrypto crates and host-seeded ChaCha20. Other three site identities and UMID/runtime-info are not included.
sources.historicalAttribution: Native module comments name Qoder-Proxy/src/{cosy,encoding,protocol,models,upstream,chat}.mjs. Those comments do not identify an exact repository revision; no matching revision is fabricated here.

sources.purpose: Preserve the existing repository's documented Qoder protocol attribution chain
sources.limitation: The original CLIProxyAPI import revision is not recorded by the existing source.

dependencies.note: Crypto implementations are linked crates rather than copied source; no custom encryption primitive or operating-system random source is added. Dependency notices remain subject to the package collector.
